blocks.text: What does it take to stand out online? From presenting products through live selling to creating engaging content and building a recognizable personal brand, digital commerce is changing how entrepreneurs connect with customers. These activities will be among the experiences at the E-Commerce Expo Philippines (ECOMEX) 2026, happening November 20–21 at the SMX Convention Center Aura in Taguig City. Powered by the Philippine SME Business Expo & Network (PHILSME), the expo expects 5,000+ attendees, with 100+ exhibitors, 160+ business solutions and over 40 speakers. Eight interactive zones to explore ECOMEX will feature eight dedicated spaces bringing digital business activities into the […]...
